bug_semantics: FlyEnv's Electron renderer injects unsanitized HTML into Vue v-html. The exploitable network path is Ollama chat: untrusted model/server text is rendered with MarkdownItAsync({ html: true }) so raw HTML (for example ) survives into src/render/components/AI/Chat/Ollama/content.vue v-html="result". Script then runs in the renderer, which can call FlyEnvNodeAPI.ipcSendToMain and reach AppNodeFn.exec_exec for RCE. A second patched sink is src/render/components/AI/Chat/Main/index.vue v-html of raw item.content (local assistant HTML). Other markdown v-html consumers (MarkdownPreview, CodeLibrary, SkillView) share the same unsanitized md.render() output.
flaw_origin: The XSS mechanism first became complete on 2025-03-04 in d0259bcabf37947f9a2e27a60a26bddef95f2b57 ("1. Add Ollama Module"). That commit added a VitePress-style markdown stack at src/render/util/markdown/markdown.ts with html: true and rewired Ollama/content.vue from markdown-it() defaults (html: false, which escapes raw HTML) to createMarkdownRenderer() with no sanitizer. Parent 036c0e93 already had v-html of Ollama markdown, but not HTML pass-through. Later ade8411f only moved rendering behind IPC md.render; it did not introduce the flaw. The 2024 AI/Chat/Main v-html change is a weaker local-assistant sink, not the network markdown XSS.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2026-69116 / GHSA-w92g-j683-fhvq is a published CWE-79, not withdrawn or rejected. The confirmed mechanism is unsanitized HTML from markdown (html: true) and chat content reaching Vue v-html in the Electron renderer, with XSS escalating via the preload IPC exec bridge. Researcher PoC and root-cause lines are Ollama chat + MarkdownItAsync({ html: true }). BIC search used those sinks, not an AI-marker hunt. git log -L on Ollama/content.vue shows v-html first appearing in 036c0e93 (markdown-it defaults). git log -S / blame on markdown.ts html: true first-writes d0259bca, which also rewires Ollama to that renderer. Parent-tree verification shows html: true and markdown.ts absent at 036c0e93, so the raw-HTML XSS mechanism is not yet present there. d0259bca is therefore the smallest public commit that first wrote the flawed mechanism; it is a first-write, not a move/revert. The later IPC refactor only relocated the same unsanitized render. The 2024 AI/Chat/Main v-html is a related sink the same patch closed, but it is app-generated local-assistant HTML and is not the network markdown XSS. AI judgment is BIC-only: d0259bca is human maintainer 徐鹏飞 with no commit-object AI marker, so verdict is NOT_AI. Fix SHA is the GitHub squash landing 68fd6d7 referenced by the advisory and contained in v4.18.0.
